shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && printf '\\n--- dod ---\\n' && cat .lore/dod.md && printf '\\n--- test commands ---\\n' && cat .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && printf '\\n--- implementation ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && printf '\\n--- root files ---\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '*test*' -g 'package.json' -g 'scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs' -g '.lore/**' | head -100 && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && cat package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat AGENTS.md && printf '\\n--- lore files ---\\n' && rg --files .lore && printf '\\n--- test remainder ---\\n' && sed -n '260,430p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && printf '\\n--- descriptor commands ---\\n' && cat .lore/test-commands.yml && printf '\\n--- reanchor ---\\n' && ls scripts/spec-links"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs && rg -n 'test anchor|spec anchor|specs/.*#[0-9]|specs/<|descriptor' .lore scripts | head -80"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/["'^ ]+#[0-9]+|spec-anchor|spec anchor|spec='"' src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -60 && ls scripts | grep lore-run && sed -n '1,160p' scripts/lore-run-test.mjs"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '15,27p'; sed -n '1,10p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; git diff --stat && git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs && git status --short && git diff --check'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "test(orchestrator): pin beforeSession failure hooks" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch && git status -sb && git rev-parse --short HEAD && git rev-parse --short @{u}'
